CROP_Y = 0          # top edge of the crop in the original video (px)
CROP_WIDTH = 1920   # width of the crop region (px)
CROP_HEIGHT = 1080  # height of the crop region (px)

TRACKER_WIDTH = None   # e.g. 640 if the crop is resized before tracking
TRACKER_HEIGHT = None  # e.g. 360

def to_tracker(x, y,
               crop_x=None, crop_y=None,
               crop_width=None, crop_height=None,
               tracker_width=None, tracker_height=None):
    """Convert an (x, y) pixel position in the original video to tracker coordinates.

    Any argument left as None falls back to the module-level configuration.
    Returns a tuple (x, y) of floats. Points outside the crop are still mapped

    th = TRACKER_HEIGHT if tracker_height is None else tracker_height

    cy = CROP_Y if crop_y is None else crop_y
    cw = CROP_WIDTH if crop_width is None else crop_width
    ch = CROP_HEIGHT if crop_height is None else crop_height
